periods.label: 白衣骑士的诊断

status.current: competes in Seven Stars while monitoring Moroboshi and diagnosing Ikki's abnormal state

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Former patient; she reconstructed his legs and still performs personal follow-up checks.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Potential D-block opponent and fellow water user, but much more medically specialized.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Finds him attractive, checks his condition, and warns that something mental may be wrong during the Moroboshi match.
relationships.yui-tatara: Restrains Tatara's body through medical water manipulation during the banquet.

periods.summary: Kiriko first appears at the banquet, where she restrains Tatara by manipulating her body fluids and diagnoses her as an unruly patient. The next day she visits Moroboshi's family restaurant because she wants to check on Yuudai before the tournament. She reveals to Shizuku and Alice the truth behind Moroboshi's reconstructed legs, the hellish rehabilitation she performed, and the brotherly obligation that drives him. During Ikki's match she detects that his physical state is normal but his reactions are abnormal, then hears Kurono explain that the problem is not trauma but the body failing to interpret the Edelweiss-derived combat signal.

key_events.summary: Stops Tatara by controlling her body and offers medical advice.
Explains Moroboshi's accident, reconstructed legs and motive.
Diagnoses Ikki from the stands during the duel.

abilities: body control through blood and lymph

periods.time: Seven Stars first round D-block opening
periods.label: 白衣骑士被迫离场

status.current: withdraws from Seven Stars to treat every inpatient at her hospital
status.tournament: D-block match against Amane forfeited before it begins

personality.summary: A doctor before she is a knight; she can be playful, but when patients are endangered she immediately prioritizes medical duty over competition.
fears: patients dying while she is away

abilities_owned: water/body-fluid related combat implied by water-cycling concerns

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Watches his matches and warns/teases him; Ikki is curious about her combat ability.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Potential D-block rival whose water-based ability may fare poorly against Stella's Brute Dragon Roar.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Scheduled opponent whose wish causes the hospital crisis that forces her withdrawal.
relationships.kajihara-mio: Deputy hospital director who calls her in panic when all inpatients become critical.

periods.summary: Kiriko observes Stella's B-block match with Ikki's group and recognizes the danger of Brute Dragon Roar for her own regenerative or body-fluid techniques. She is scheduled to fight Amane in D-block, but Amane casually says the match will not happen. Immediately afterward her hospital calls: every inpatient has simultaneously become critical, an impossible mass deterioration that she knows cannot be explained by her misdiagnosis. As a doctor, she instantly requests a helicopter and forfeits the match, though she confronts Amane first and nearly attacks before realizing his wish power could create even worse collateral casualties.

key_events.summary: Hospital emergency forces her to abandon the tournament before facing Amane.
Her crisis becomes the key proof for Ikki's deduction of Amane's true ability.

periods.label: 击退死神的白衣骑士
titles: 巨门学园代表候补/七星选手

status.current: saves Ikki from Amane's death-result curse and sends Amane a taunting message
status.tournament: was forced to withdraw from first round by Amane's luck

personality.summary: Confident, blunt and professional; treats even a death-result curse as another death god to beat as a doctor.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Emergency patient she saves after Amane's death result keeps dragging his body toward death.
relationships.amane-shinomiya: Her first-round loss was caused by his luck; after saving Ikki she sends the message that the debt is repaid.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Reassures Shizuku by declaring that defeating one or two death gods is part of being a doctor.

periods.summary: When Ikki's body repeatedly shifts from one fatal crisis to another after his heart is restarted, Kiriko arrives at the medical facility after being contacted by Itsuki. Shizuku asks whether she can save him, and Kiriko rejects the doubt, saying a doctor must be able to crush one or two death gods deceiving a patient. Her treatment succeeds where ordinary resuscitation cannot. Later Nene tells Amane that Kiriko's message is: the first-round account has been repaid, and it serves him right.

key_events.summary: Arrives and saves Ikki from Amane's lingering death result.
Has Nene relay that she repaid Amane for the first-round withdrawal.
